top5.title: Jensen Huang Resigns as Head of Nvidia
top5.description: Jensen Huang reportedly resigned as CEO of Nvidia after reports emerged of two alleged affairs with Chinese spies. Nvidia’s valuation fell by 800 billion dollars following the controversy.
top5.why: Jensen Huang’s reported resignation sent Nvidia’s valuation sharply lower and raises major questions about the leadership and direction of the company at the center of the AI-chip market.

top5.title: A Global Microsoft 365 Outage Affects Outlook and Teams
top5.description: A global Microsoft 365 outage crippled Outlook, Teams, Copilot and other services. Microsoft attributed it to an overloaded secure-connection process and said it was not a cyberattack.
top5.why: The global Microsoft 365 outage disrupted Outlook, Teams, Copilot and other enterprise services, highlighting the operational and concentration risks of cloud dependence.

top5.title: Google Launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen for Coding Assistants
top5.description: Google launched Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a model designed for coding assistants and software that uses tools. It accepts text, images, audio and video, with adjustable reasoning levels and usage-based pricing.
top5.why: Google’s launch of Gemini 4 Hydrogen intensifies competition in coding assistants and tool-using AI while expanding the market for multimodal, usage-priced models.

top5.title: Open standards aim to simplify the development of interoperable AI agents
top5.description: Anthropic’s donation of the Model Context Protocol and Agent Skills to the Linux Foundation’s Agentic AI Foundation establishes complementary standards to limit fragmentation in AI-agent ecosystems. MCP standardizes real-time connections to tools and data, while Agent Skills progressively loads the procedural knowledge required.
top5.why: Anthropic’s contribution of the Model Context Protocol and Agent Skills to a Linux Foundation project could establish important open standards for interoperable AI agents.

top5.title: Australia wants to require independent audits of cutting-edge AI
top5.description: The Australian government is proposing mandatory safety rules for companies developing the most advanced models. A regulator could have these models audited by independent experts and impose penalties.
top5.why: Australia’s proposal for mandatory independent audits and penalties for cutting-edge AI developers signals a shift toward enforceable international safety regulation.
